name: Creative Composites Group, Augusta Molding Division
old_description: Creative Composites Group can help you advance your infrastructure projects beyond the limitations of traditional materials. We are the largest manufacturer of structural composites in the U.S. with innovative products across multiple industries.
about:
Creative Composites Group's Augusta Molding Division operates as Kenway Composites at 681 Riverside Drive in Augusta, Maine. The division is part of the Creative Composites Group, a collection of U.S.-based structural composite manufacturers owned by Hill & Smith Holdings PLC, a UK-headquartered international group with divisions in Engineered Solutions, Roads & Security, and Galvanizing Services. No founding year or individual founders are disclosed for the Augusta operation; the group emphasizes decades of combined experience across its member companies.

The division produces fiber-reinforced polymer (FRP) composites for structural applications, offering turnkey design-build, structural fabrication, manufacturing, engineering, and field services. Capabilities span custom FRP platforms, handrails, stairs, walkways, ladders, cage systems, tanks, towers, and linings, with production ranging from one-off molded fabrications to high-volume runs. The group's eight member companies—including Creative Pultrusions, Enduro Composites, and Composite Advantage—operate facilities across Pennsylvania, Ohio, Oklahoma, Texas, and Maine, providing vertically integrated composite design and advanced manufacturing.

Primary markets include telecommunications and data centers, energy generation and distribution, marine, rail, and housing, as well as pulp and paper, water and wastewater treatment, and chemical storage. The company cites pulp mill washer system repairs and custom chemical storage tank installations as examples of its field service work, and notes that its engineering staff can deliver Professional Engineer-stamped blueprints for infrastructure projects.

Creative Composites Group positions itself as the largest U.S. manufacturer of structural composites, differentiating through vertical integration of multiple composite brands, in-house engineering, and over 60 years of collective FRP field service experience. The organization states it was formed to combine the expertise of its member companies to deliver engineered composite systems that are lightweight, corrosion-resistant, and long-lasting for infrastructure projects of any scope.
